name: attention
description: Attention sensors — hook-only L1 plugin whose Claude lifecycle-hook sensors feed allowlisted runtime-owned executors (ADR-0040 §3, amended by ADR-0044 §2 and ADR-0045 §2): notify.mjs emit for operator notifications, context.mjs publish-session for session capture, and context.mjs entry-brief for the entry arbiter. Registers Notification (permission_prompt → approval/urgent, idle_prompt → idle), Stop (session-capture spawn ordered before notification work — short-circuits never skip capture, capture failure never skips notification — then workflow-terminal behind a freshness-checked session-handoff projection read, else bare turn-complete), SubagentStop (subagent-complete), and SessionStart (explicit startup matcher + explicit 15 s timeout: spawns the entry-brief arbiter and relays at most one validated marker-paired line into context — the scoped ADR-0045 §2.2 stdout exception; every notify-pipeline sensor stays stdout-silent). Hooks + sensor scripts only: no skills, no verbs, no state machinery. Sensors are fail-closed observers (exit 0 always, no decision output) that resolve the runtime plugin root via a version-gated discover-runtime ladder with triple floors that never share a constant: notify >= 0.71.0 (code-pinned), publish-session >= 0.82.0 and entry-brief >= 0.83.0 (each declared in data/runtime-floors.json byte-for-byte with its spawn gate); notifications stay off until the operator sets a notify_channel, capture until session_capture, and the entry line until the user-scope-only entry_brief key, all via runtime:settings.
